The '''2024–25 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team''' represented [[Central Connecticut State University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Devils, led by fourth-year head coach [[Patrick Sellers]], played their home games at the [[William H. Detrick Gymnasium]] in [[New Britain, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Northeast Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 Central Connecticut Blue Devils men's basketball team|Blue Devils]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 20–11, 13–3 in [[2023–24 Northeast Conference men's basketball season|NEC play]] to finish in a tie for first place. In the [[2024 Northeast Conference men's basketball tournament|NEC tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis (PA)]] in the quarterfinals,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hartman |first=Jason |title=CCSU Men's Basketball Wins First Tournament Game Since 2011 |url=https://centralrecorder.org/83824/sports/ccsu-mens-basketball-wins-first-tournament-game-since-2011/ |access-date=2024-11-24 |website=The Recorder}}</ref> before falling to [[2023–24 Wagner Seahawks men's basketball team|Wagner]] in the semifinals.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hartman |first=Jason |title=Blue Devils Fall In NEC Tournament |url=https://centralrecorder.org/83908/sports/blue-devils-fall-in-nec-tournament/ |access-date=2024-11-24 |website=The Recorder}}</ref>

==Preseason polls==
===Northeast Conference poll===
The Northeast Conference released its preseason coaches' poll on October 24, 2024. The Blue Devils were picked to finish in a tie for first place in the conference.<ref name=coachpoll>{{cite web|url=https://northeastconference.org/news/2024/10/23/MBB_PreseasonMBBPoll_2425.aspx|title=Preseason Power Play: Wagner and CCSU Rise to Top In Deadlocked #NECMBB Coaches' Poll|website=Northeast Conference|access-date=November 26, 2024}}</ref>
